correctness.rationale: For every n>=3, the no-11/no-000 cyclic-word condition is equivalent to maximal independence and leads bijectively to the stated three-state integer transfer trace, with each negative vertex sign applied exactly once. Its unweighted trace satisfies the Perrin order-three recurrence (3,0,2), and the fixed-vertex cardinalities satisfy the compositions-of-2-and-3 recurrence (1,0,1). Verifying finite recurrence-state triples proves periods 7 modulo 2 and 14 modulo 4. The congruence W(b)=P_n-2|b|Q_n (mod 4) yields W(b)=2 (mod 4) whenever n=8 (mod 14); odd P_n rules out all other zero-free cases. Exact products with the five displayed frequency sign sets have trace zero, while the seven-letter sign-block product is an involution, so two copies extend each witness by 14. This exhausts all n>=3. The standalone checker independently enumerated signed maximal-independent-set sums through n=10, full spectra through n=18, all seed products, and modular patterns. The proof is for all n; finite tests are corroboration, not an extrapolation.

originality.rationale: The central prior Bisdorff–Marichal manuscript (read throughout) gives the unweighted Perrin cycle counts and circular two-/three-gap descriptions, and counts dihedral orbits. These results specialize to frequency zero but do not force or forbid any of the remaining signed Fourier coefficients. A published 2026 cycle maximal-independent-set incidence-context study was read in full; it computes implication bases and Boolean trace dimension rather than the signed Walsh transform. A related path maximal-independent-set result has a different (open-boundary) transfer functional and mod-seven criterion; it does not entail the cyclic trace and its extra modulo-fourteen zero-free class. Bounded direct searches of signed enumerators and Fourier aliases did not find an equivalent all-cycle zero classification; older unindexed multivariate signed-polymer treatments remain a real priority risk.

value.rationale: Convolution invertibility of the incidence indicator is a natural full-Fourier-support invariant. The theorem classifies all cycle lengths rather than an ad hoc finite sample, and it isolates a meaningful arithmetic boundary: n=8 (mod 14) has even total count yet no cancelling frequencies, whereas the five other even-count residue classes have explicit zero witnesses propagated by an integral order-two transfer word. The general modular classification is not the ordinary Perrin parity test and supplies a concrete structural distinction between cyclic and open-boundary independent domination.
